in_marathi.name: Bageshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bageshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bageshwari is the Goddess of Fortune and Prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is also known as Bagalamukhi, the one who crushes the evil with her enchanting gaze. This powerful goddess bestows her blessings upon her devotees, granting them wealth, prosperity, and protection from adversities.
